expectations.text: Cites Implementing Regulation (EU) 2026/1755, published in the OJ July 21, 2026 and in force August 10, 2026
expectations.evidence: "Commission Implementing Regulation (EU) 2026/1755. It was published in the Official Journal on 21 July 2026 and entered into force on 10 August 2026."

expectations.text: Covers model evaluations including API, source code and model access under Article 92(3)
expectations.evidence: "Model evaluations (Art. 92). It sets how evaluations are run, including access through APIs, to source code, and to the model itself."

expectations.text: Covers the appointment and independence of external experts
expectations.evidence: "It covers how independent experts are appointed to carry out evaluations and how their independence is ensured."

expectations.text: Covers fine proceedings: preliminary findings, the right to be heard, and access to the file
expectations.evidence: "The Commission issues preliminary findings, the provider has a right to be heard" plus "Access to the file. The provider can see the evidence the Commission relies on"

expectations.text: States the five-year limitation period for fines
expectations.evidence: "There is a five-year limitation period for the Commission's power to impose penalties."
